seo.title: Luis Schulz – Triathlete and coach
seo.description: I'm Luis, a triathlete turning pro in 2027. Here you'll find my races, my coaching and how you can support me.

heroText: I'm racing as a professional from 2027. I also coach a small number of athletes whom I support personally.
introText:
On this site you'll find out where I come from, which races I'm planning and how it's going.

You'll also see how I work as a coach. I train every day myself and I know what a hard training block feels like. That experience goes into every plan I write.

pillars.title: About me
pillars.text: Where I come from and what I've set out to do.

pillars.title: Coaching
pillars.text: I coach you personally and plan your training in TrainingPeaks. I reply to messages within 3 hours.

pillars.title: Partners
pillars.text: I'm looking for companies to support me on my way into professional racing.

ctaText: Whether you're interested in coaching, want to support me or have a press enquiry: I read every message myself and will get back to you.
